tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyag tshad mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ gzhal yas khang gi 'og gzhi sna tshogs rwa nyi shu par byed na rtse lnga pa'i rwa gzhan gnyis kyang g.yas g.yon du sbrags te yod rdo rje'i lte ba gru bzhi pa'i rgyar cha chen bcu gnyis/ bri bya la mda' yab kyi thig dang tha mi dad du yod/ dbyibs chos dbyings gsung dbang sogs dkyil 'khor zlum po 'ga' zhig la zlum po gru bzhi la gru bzhi'o/ dpangs su cha chen gcig cha chen 'dom gru bzhi 'dom gang dang khru re la sor mo nyer bzhi'o/ dang cha phran khru re yin kyang / dkyil 'khor che chung thams cad la rtsir yod de thig las shes so/ /rwa rtse nas rwa rtse'i bar la cha chen bcu drug cha phran drug cu re bzhi/ nyi ma dang pad+ma'i lte ba gnyis rdo rje'i zur dang mnyam/ pad 'dab cha phran gnyis/ khor yug dur khrod dang chos 'byung rdo rwa me ri sogs yin/ rtsig pa ni dbus nas phyi rol du bgrangs pa'i cha chen bzhi dor nas/ lnga pa la dbus dor mtha' gnyis btab pa'i mtha' nang ma cha phran gcig la/ dpangs cha chen bzhi/ cha phran bcu drug phyi nang sbags mar brtsigs/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gcig zheng du cha phran phyed gnyis kyi phyi ru 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du drwa ba drwa phyed kyi sa la bar stong cha phran gnyis yod pa las/ skabs skabs su rin po che'i bre phul zhes pa/ dpangs su cha phran phyed phyed kyis 'phags pa'i bzhi brtsegs phyogs bzhir brgyad brgyad/ zur bzhir bzhi ste sum cu so drug de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb zheng la cha phran gcig dpangs su cha phran gcig gi lnga cha thig skud gang yin gcig de'i phyi ngos nas chu srin nam/ zi pa tra'i kha nas 'thon pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed pha gu'i bar du 'phyang ba/ gser gyi ska rags dang nang gi gdung mnyam por byas pa'i steng nas thog phub pa'i gcam gyi bya 'dab 'og gi 'dod snam dang thad mnyam por yod pa'i mtha' bskor las thur du 'phyang ba'i shar bu'am/

mda' yab kyi ming can spyi blugs mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu'am/ rus rgyan rnying pa'i za ra tshags kyi sne mo'i rnam pa can gang rung thur du 'phyang ba/ steng du langs pa pu shu'am mda' yab kyi ming can/ drwa mig gseng ma cha phran gcig khor yug tu yod pa/ thog rnams phub tshul la/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du lha snam phyogs mdog can/ rgyar sgo'i nang nas khor yug tu cha phran chen yin nam re re/ dpangs su cha phran gcig dbus su lha snam sngon po rgyar cha chen gcig dpangs su cha phran gnyis/ de lta bu'i lha snam cha phran gcig pa'i steng du tshangs thig nas cha phran lnga dor ba'i mtha' rnams su ka ba phyogs mdog can gnyis gnyis/ dpangs su cha phran bcu drug yod pa brgyad 'dzugs/ rtsig pa'i nang nas ji tsam dor ba'i sar 'dzugs snyam na/ de'i steng gi gdung zlum phyogs bzhi'i sgo'i thad kyi rtsig pa la reg dgos pas/ de dang ka ba gnyis phrad pa'i sa ni/ tshangs thig nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran lnga re phyin pa'i sar nang gi gdung zlum gyi 'gros dang 'tshams par 'dzugs shing brtsegs ni ka ba de dag gi steng du gdud zlum gyi 'gros dang 'dra ba'i cha phran gcig dang / cha phran gcig gi lnga cha'i dpangs la zhu ring thung gi rnam pa ji ltar mdzes pa'o/ /gdung ni de dag gi steng du gdung cha phran gcig zlum por bskor ba'o/ /gdung la rdo rjes mtshan zhing ka ba ni shar du 'khor lo/ /lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'o/ /thog phub rim pa gsum ni/ gdung zlum de dang phyi'i gser gyi ska rags mnyam por yod pa'i steng du gcam btang ste/ phyi gru bzhi dang / nang zlum po'i tshul gyis phub pa ni thog phub 'og ma'o/ /gdung zlum gyi steng du brtsigs zlum zur thig gis bcad pa'i phyogs mdog can/ dpangs su cha 'dir zlum po 'khor bcas la cha phran drug dgos pas rtseg pa la cha phran bzhi bya/

des na 'dir thog bar 'og gnyis kyi 'gebs kyi mthug srab kyang dpangs la brtsis pas thog dpangs so gnyis 'brig go phran gsum/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gcig gi sum cha/ drwa ba cha phran gcig de'i steng du gdung leb cha phran gcig gi lnga cha/ de'i steng gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bres pa'i gdung phrad mtshams 'phel kha sprad pa'i rnam pa can/ phyogs mtshams kyi re mig brgyad zlum por phub/ bya 'dab dang mda' yab pu shu rnams snga ma bzhin byas pa thog phub bar ma'o/ /re mig dbus ma'i steng du gdung stegs brtsigs pa grub bzhi sngon po cha phran gsum/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran sum cha/ drwa ba cha phran sum gnyis/ de steng gdung leb dang bcas pas thog khad mnyam par phub/ bya 'dab mda' yab pu shu rnams sngar bzhin la/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa thog phub gsum pa'o/ /de ltar na sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba nas thog phub gong ma'i bar cha chen brgyad dang / rtsig pa'i nang mtha' nas nang mtha'i bar la cha chen brgyad yod par mnyam pa ni/ lus yas mar dang phan tshun 'dom gang bar mnyam pa mtshon nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang las/ 'phang du dpag tshad gsum/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga yod par gsungs pa'i don/ shar nub tu cha chen brgyad/ cha phran sum cu so gnyis su yod pa/ de nyid dum bu lngar bgos pa'i dum bu re re ni dpag tshad re rer byas pas/ 'dir dpag tshad re la cha phran drug re dang / cha phran gcig gi lnga gnyis re thob ste/ de ltar rgyar dpag tshad lnga zhes pa'i don no/ /dpangs su dpag tshad gsum pa ni gru bzhi pa'i thog man chad kyi dpangs yin pas/ cha phran bcu dgu dang / cha phran gcig gi lnga cha ste/ mdor na rtsig pa'i dpangs cha chen bzhi la pha gu la cha phran gcig drwa phyed la cha phran gnyis/ gser gyi ska rags cha phran gcig gi lnga cha ste/ 'di man chad dpag tshad gsum yin la/ ska rags dang nang gi gdung dpangs mnyam pa'i steng nas thog 'bubs pa yin no/

/sgo ni dpangs su cha chen gnyis yod pa/ 'dzud pa ni rtsa thig nas g.yas g.yon gyi mdun ngos su cha chen gcig song ba ni sgo 'khyud/ de gnyis las g.yas g.yon du cha phran gnyis re song ba ni sgo 'gram/ yang de gnyis las mdun ngos su nang du cha phran gsum phyi ru cha chen gcig song ba ni sgo logs yin/ sgo logs kyi rtsig pa lnga po snyug bri'i so ltar gseg gcod do/ /sgo 'khyud kyi phyi 'gram du re bzhi dang bcas pa'i sgo nyis dral gyi dbyibs ci mdzes su 'dzud par byed do/ sgo rnams 'byed gcod nang du byed/ /rta babs ni 'dir blos bslang gi dbang du byas na/ rta babs sgo gdong la sbyor ba'i tshe sgo logs nas sgo logs kyi bar du gdung cha chen gcig btang ba'i steng du ya phub kyi rtsigs rgyun cha phran gcig de thams cad kyi dpangs su cha phran dgu/ de rnams kyi steng thog mnyam par phub/ sgo 'gram gyi phyi mtha' dang / sgo logs kyi phyi mtha' gnyis su rta babs kyi ka ba dpangs su cha phran lnga pa/ ka rgyan dang bcas pa bzhi bzhi btsugs pa/ de'i steng du sgo 'gram gyi phyin nas sgo logs kyi bar mdun du 'ong zhing / de nas sgo logs cig shos kyi bar ngos su song ba/ de nas sgo 'gram gcig shos kyi bar rgyab du song bar gyur pa'i rdo rje'i gdung 'god/ de'i steng du rta babs rnams brtsigs te/ ka rgyan gyi steng du cha phran gcig pa/ de nas ka ba'i steng du bang rim gnyis pa la cha phran gcig gis thung ba/ de nas mun snam gyi steng du bang rim gsum pa sngar bas cha phran gcig gis thung ba/ de nas sgo khang cha phran gcig gis thung ba rnams ni rim pa bzhi ste/ de'i steng du pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs sogs 'god do/ /de ltar na rta babs ka ba dang bcas pa'i dpangs cha phran dgu yin la/ de bzhin du rtsa ba'i sgo dang / sgo 'khyud dang / 'gram logs rnams kyi dpangs kyang cha phran dgu dang /

sgo'i dpangs kyang sngar bshad pa ltar cha chen gnyis yin no/ /de ltar g.yas g.yon gyi rta babs ni ring thung gi tshul du gnas la/ sgo mdun gyi rta babs kyi logs mnyam por yod kyang / kha dog mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis snam bu bzhi yod do/ /zhes pa ni rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis bzhed pa'o/ /mus chen sangs rin gyis ni/ rje btsun gyis lo hi pa'i sgrub thabs las gsungs pa'i don kyang 'di dang sbyor bar bzhed kun mkhyen go rams pas ni gsung de'i don 'di ltar bzhed de/ spyir sgo khang bris pa bzhin brtsigs nas yod par 'dod la/ dmigs gsal bri bya'i ya phub ni sgo'i dngos gzhi'i thad kyi rtsig rgyun ma chad pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ der bris pa yin gyi bsgom bya la ya phub kyi thad kyi rtsig pa med par 'dod do/ /'o na bsgom bya la rtsig rgyun chad par 'gyur ro snyam na ma yin te/ sgo'i steng du yang cha chen gnyis kyi rtsig rgyun ma chad par yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rta babs kyi sgo khang gi steng 'gebs dgos pas/ sgo logs kyi phyi mtha' cha phran re re song ba'i bar nang ngos 'dod snam la reg pa dang / phyi ngos sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba zad mtshams su stegs bu gru bzhi dpangs su cha phran cig de'i steng du bum pa cha phran gcig de'i steng du ka ba cha phran lnga pa bzhi 'dzugs so/ /de dag gi steng du zhu ring thung gnyis la dpangs su cha phran gcig srid du zhu ring cha phran gnyis yod pa/ rtse mos ka rgyan dang mun pa'i phyed non pa'i tshul yod pa'o/ /de'i steng du mdun ngos la gdung / dkyus su cha chen bzhi/ dpangs su cha phran gcig yod pa dang / ka ba nang ma gnyis gnyis kyi steng du yang de dang mnyam pa'i gdung 'god do/ /de'i steng du rta babs snam bu 'og ma dkyus su cha chen bzhi/ zheng du cha phran lnga yod pas bkab/ de'i steng du snam bu gong ma gsum g.yas g.yon dang / mdun ngos su cha phran re res thung ba brtsegs te/

mchod rten gyi bang rim ltar yod pa'i steng ma la dkyus su cha phran bcu dang / zheng du cha phran gnyis yod pa'o/ /de'i dbus su pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs gsum cha chen gcig gi tshad dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo gnyis dang / mjug ma'i ngos su gdugs 'dzin pa'i spre'u gnyis dang / snam bu'i rim pa rnams la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /snam bu bzhi char gyi nang ngos mnyam pa dang / sgo'i steng gi logs kyi rtsig pa'i bar na cha phran gnyis stong par yod pa ni rtsigs pa'i dngos gzhi dang / rta babs kyi bar du nam mkha' stong pa dang bcas pa'i don yin cing / sgo khang gi rtsig pa dang / rta babs kyi bar na cha phran gcig yod pa ni ka pa bzhis mtho bar bteg pa zhes dang / ka ba bzhi dgos pa'i don kyang yin no/ /sgo khang gi rtsig pa'i dpangs ni/ rta babs sgo gdong la sbyar ba ltar na cha phran dgu dgos shing / rta babs kyis 'gebs pa ltar na/ rtsa ba'i sgo dang mnyam par cha phran brgyad do/ /nang gi dbyibs ni/ kyai rdor man ngag lugs ltar na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyi rol tu rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pas bskor ba ni/ yab kyi phyogs la 'phar ma gcig pa'i don to/ /sgrub byed mtha' dpyod rnams bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab la rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni rang dang rang 'dra'i blo dman gzhan la'ang phan sems kyis dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ shu bhaṃ bha wan+tu/ 'di ni blos bslang lag len gyi tshig dogs gnas rnams khungs dpyad bla ma'i gsung rgyun bcas mchan bus gsal ba sogs yid brtan thub pa yin no// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gzhal yas khang gi phyag tshad mdor bsdus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
